com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Remove the selected category's monthly budget in one currency. Invoice history and budgets in other currencies remain. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview removing this workspace’s monthly fuel budget in USD. Keep the invoices and wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_delete_budget, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare removing only the exact category/currency budget. Invoice history and budgets in other currencies remain. Requires settings permission and confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

name: delete_budget
title: Remove a monthly budget
